text: Migraine with or without aura, per ICHD-3 criteria
sub_conditions: Diagnosis of migraine with aura OR migraine without aura

text: History of failure with prior preventive migraine treatments
sub_conditions: Prior use of at least one migraine preventive treatment
Documented lack of efficacy/failure (or intolerance) of that preventive treatment

text: Not currently using migraine preventive therapy
sub_conditions: No ongoing/current migraine preventive medication use

text: Difficulty distinguishing migraine from other headache types or presence of other primary headache disorders
sub_conditions: Inability to reliably differentiate migraine attacks from other headache types
Presence of another primary headache disorder (e.g., cluster headache, tension-type headache disorder)
Current or recent use of protocol-prohibited medications

text: Any clinically significant medical, psychiatric, neurological, cardiovascular, or laboratory abnormalities
